capabilities: Export notes to PDF with a live export preview
Add outline bookmarks, page numbers and header/footer templates to exported PDFs
Set PDF metadata (title, author, keywords) from frontmatter
Merge multiple Markdown files or a folder into one PDF via a table-of-contents note
Batch export each file in a folder to separate PDFs
extras: Donations accepted via PayPal, WeChat and Alipay. The TODO list marks 'Export multiple Markdown files into one PDF file' as unfinished, though the features list claims it, so that capability may be incomplete. Custom styling relies on Obsidian CSS snippets and Electron's printToPDF options.
intentEvidence: Compared to the official Export PDF feature
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF export lacks export preview, outline bookmarks, page numbers, custom margins, PDF metadata and multi-file or batch export.
summary: PDF export enhancer that exports notes with outline bookmarks, page numbers, export preview, custom margins, frontmatter metadata and multi-file merging.
